Title: CIS Docker Community Edition Benchmark
Description: CIS Docker Community Edition Benchmark v1.6.0

Results.Name: Ensure that a user for the container has been created
Results.Description: Create a non-root user for the container in the Dockerfile for the container image.

Misconfigurations.Title: Image user should not be 'root'
Misconfigurations.Description: Running containers with 'root' user can lead to a container escape situation.
Misconfigurations.Message: Specify at least 1 USER command in Dockerfile with non-root user as argument
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Add 'USER <non root user name>' line to the Dockerfile

Results.Name: Ensure that HEALTHCHECK instructions have been added to container images
Results.Description: Add the HEALTHCHECK instruction in the container image Dockerfile.

Misconfigurations.Title: No HEALTHCHECK defined
Misconfigurations.Description: Health checks tell Docker how to determine a container is still working.
Misconfigurations.Message: Add HEALTHCHECK instruction in your Dockerfile

Results.Name: Ensure privileged ports are not mapped within containers
Results.Description: The TCP/IP port numbers below 1024 are considered privileged ports.

Results.Name: Ensure a separate partition for containers has been created
Results.Description: Manual control with no automated check.

Results.Name: Ensure that unnecessary packages are not installed in the container
Results.Description: Containers tend to be minimal and slim down.
